decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric is close to the firm's core upholstery know-how and has its own website page, so the firm can read its market response well and refine it with its in-house development.

The semi-transparent bouclé decorative fabric draws directly on the firm's established decoration expertise, but it is only mentioned on the website, which suggests lower prominence and some risk of being pruned when the collection rotates.
Flame-retardant jacquard curtains for contract and hospitality projects match the firm's functional-fabric knowledge and its strategic focus, and the product's own website page signals commitment.

The double-face wool-blend fabric extends existing capabilities and fits the shift toward renewable materials, though its low website visibility leaves its role uncertain as blends that are hard to recycle are reduced.
The wool bouclé leno builds on the firm's sheer-fabric and wool know-how and supports the sustainability direction, so the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve it rather than drop it.
